ns2:course.label: Middle East in 20th Century
ns2:course.description: Political-economic, social and ideological developments in Egypt, Arabia, and Fertile Crescent (including Israel), Iran and Turkey since 1918 to the present, including U.S. involvement. Prerequisite: One year of college history or social science, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One year of college history or social science, or consent of instructor.
